title: Forming and Shaping Complex Components
objective: Understand why complex forming and shaping requires accurate controlled information and authorised processes.
safety_boundary: Theory only; no operational forming or shaping procedures.

sections.heading: 1. Complex components
sections.body: Complex components may combine several dimensions, curves, transitions or relationships that must meet the design requirement.

sections.heading: 2. Controlled information
sections.body: Drawings, templates and specifications provide the required geometry and acceptance information.

sections.heading: 3. Verification
sections.body: Dimensions and references must remain consistent with the controlled source throughout fabrication planning.

sections.heading: 4. Practical boundary
sections.body: Complex forming and shaping is practical occupational work requiring authorised training, equipment and supervision.
